title: NEVAMIS cinematic frame manifest, version 1
description: One manifest describes every scroll controlled sequence on the homepage. It is the loader's only source of truth: the loader is forbidden to construct a URL, so every frame, poster, keyframe and fallback is listed explicitly here. The runtime validator that actually enforces this document is validateManifest() in assets/cinematic/manifest.js; this file is the written form of the same rules and scripts/check-cinematic-contract.mjs asserts the two agree.

kind.description: 'placeholder' frames are procedurally generated scaffolding carrying an NVFC1 code strip. 'production' frames are approved media and carry no code strip, so index reading guards report 'no-code' against them by design.

codeVersion.description: Frame code carried by these frames, e.g. NVFC1. Absent or null on production manifests.

id.description: Must equal SEQUENCE_IDS in assets/cinematic/manifest.js. The contract guard fails if this enum and that array diverge.

ordinal.description: Index of id within SEQUENCE_IDS. This is the number a placeholder frame's code strip carries, so a guard can prove it is reading the sequence it thinks it is.

sections.description: data-ia values of the homepage sections this sequence spans visually. The seven sections keep their own headings and their own single primary action; a sequence never merges them.

scrollLengthVh.description: Height of the sticky stage in vh. Must exceed 100 or there is no scroll range to map onto frames.

fit.description: Centred cover is the only implemented fit. The guards compute the code strip's canvas position from this assumption; a different fit makes them report 'no-code' rather than a wrong index.

variants.description: Both are mandatory and are separate purpose built compositions with their own dimensions and their own frame counts. Neither is a crop of the other.

media.description: The media query that selects this variant. Across a sequence the variants' queries must partition the viewport exactly: selectVariant() throws when zero or more than one matches, rather than silently defaulting.

frames.description: Every frame URL, in index order. Length must equal frameCount. Explicit rather than a pattern so the loader has no URL building code at all: a renamed output directory fails validation instead of 404ing every frame behind a poster.

frame.description: Index within this variant that the poster depicts. Must be inside the sequence.

poster.description: Painted immediately, before any sequence work. LCP never waits on the sequence and the canvas is never shown blank.

fallback.description: What a visitor sees with no JavaScript, or after the sequence fails. Required: a sequence with no fallback can only fail as a blank stage.

section.description: data-ia of the section this chapter sits against. Must be one the sequence spans.

keyframe.description: The static frame reduced motion shows for this chapter. Must lie inside startFrame..endFrame.

reducedMotionKeyframes.description: Exactly one entry per chapter. Under reduced motion nothing scrubs: each chapter shows its static keyframe and all copy, pricing, capability, demo and CTA content stays.

strides.description: Progressive loading passes, strictly decreasing, ending at 1. Pass one loads every strides[0]-th frame so any scroll position has something near it; later passes fill in. Ending anywhere but 1 means the sequence can never be complete.

decodeWindow.description: Maximum decoded frames resident at once. A rolling window, not the whole sequence.

bytesTotal.description: Sum of the frame files, for budget reporting.
